values.note: The operator's site map shows about 122 numbered RV sites: about 75 seasonal full-hookup sites, about 30 water/electric and 17 full-hookup transient sites, and 3 park-model rentals, plus 10 primitive tent sites (A-J) by the Little Muskegon River. Mostly seasonal: the operator's site map shows about 75 of about 122 RV sites as seasonal full hookup (about 61%; seasonal $2,400 + electric), with about 47 transient sites (30 W/E, 17 full hookup) sold nightly on Campspot at posted 2026 rates, so long-stay tests 2 and 4 pass.

Price gate: base $50/night (2026 water/electric, operator's rate table; Campspot June 2027 also $50 plus a $5 booking fee once per stay), exactly at but not over US$50. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Grand Rapids 61 km); the family has not stayed here.
